packs.title: Valleys, Gardens & Gorge
packs.promise: Explore museum details, adobe courtyards and wide northern New Mexico landscapes.

q.s: Connect three objects through what they are made of.
st: Choose three objects actually on display that use different materials.
Read their labels; note each named maker or community when given, plus one material detail you can see.
Give the trio an original exhibition title. Keep your interpretation separate from the labels.

q.s: Let a large landscape change your sense of scale.
st: Choose an open viewpoint in the west rest area, safely back from the edge.
Pause for one minute. Let your gaze move from a nearby plant or stone to the gorge and distant horizon.
Write three words for the change in scale.

q.s: Collect observations while leaving everything in place.
st: Follow the open main loop at an easy pace.
Find three contrasting natural forms or textures: for example a branching line, a broad surface and a fine edge. Do not collect anything.
Make a tiny texture key with three descriptions or sketches. Use what is present, without needing a wildlife sighting.

packs.title: Plaza & Ledoux
packs.promise: Follow small details from downtown adobe streets to a park and the library.

q.s: Let one artwork start an original response.
st: Ask which current gallery permits quiet pencil observation. Choose one displayed work and note its title and maker.
Look for a color relationship or rhythm. After looking, write three original lines or draw a new arrangement in response; do not copy the work.
Give your response its own title. Finish outside if a gallery rule or crowd requires it.

q.s: Find three small details in a shopping frontage.
st: Find three contrasting details visible from the open frontage: a material, a shape and a color.
Record which detail belongs to which storefront or entrance without photographing people.
Arrange your trio into a one-sentence description that someone could use to recognize this stretch.

q.s: Find one quiet minute in the town’s daily rhythm.
st: Choose an open park seat or safe place beside a path, away from active games.
Pause for one minute and notice a nearby sound, a moving shape and something still.
Write one sentence that holds all three.
